source_review_findings.title: My Actions is a flat assignment table instead of specified operational groups
source_review_findings.problem: prototype.html showView("mine") displayed a flat table of all U-01 actions without grouping into eligible, waiting, blocked, and completed sections.
source_review_findings.proposed_correction: Implement 4-tier operational queue: 1. Eligible Actions (truthful 0 at T0 with explanation), 2. Waiting On External Parties (AC-04, AC-05), 3. Blocked Actions (AC-05, AC-12), and 4. Historical / Completed (AC-01, AC-02). Clarify that AC-05 retains dual WAITING+BLOCKED status without duplicated workload.
